name: Noteri Control Plane Fallback Probe

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: noteri-control-plane-fallback-probe
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Canonical operational rules main used for the physical qualification.
  RULES_SHA: 86abe65b22781c2f608a7d7286ce3a28cd48aaaf
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"

jobs:
  probe:
    name: Qualify Noteri through Command Gateway
    if: github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, noteri, reqsys-dev]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable workflow SHA
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact approved rules candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules
          ref: ${{ env.RULES_SHA }}
          path: _rules
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify governed host qualification
        id: qualify
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          python3 -B scripts/noteri_qualification_entrypoint.py --confirm PROBE-NOTERI-CONTROL-PLANE --rules-root _rules --rules-sha "$env:RULES_SHA"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Preserve sanitized qualification or blocked diagnostic
        if: always() && steps.qualify.outputs.receipt_path != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: noteri-qualification-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.receipt_path }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  independent_readback:
    name: Independently verify qualification and select transport
    needs: probe
    if: always() && github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout same producer revision
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout identical selector
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules
          ref: ${{ env.RULES_SHA }}
          path: _rules
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Verify API job, artifact bytes, binding and selector result
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -B scripts/noteri_qualification_receipt.py verify --rules-root _rules --rules-sha "$RULES_SHA" --output .tmp/qualification-decision.json
      - name: Preserve non-promoting decision
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: noteri-qualification-decision-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .tmp/qualification-decision.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
